name: Shoulder Roll
steps: Stand or sit tall with your arms hanging loosely at your sides and your neck long.
Shrug both shoulders smoothly upward toward your ears, draw them backward together, and press them fully downward.
Sweep your shoulders gently forward to complete a wide, unhurried circular motion through your shoulder blades.
Continue rolling smoothly backward and then reverse forward for the target duration.
tips: Keep your elbows relaxed and arms heavy so the circle comes cleanly from your shoulder blades.
Move slowly and keep your chin level instead of jutting your head forward.
